components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Aqua-mint filled action button used for primary actions (login, save, add campaign).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal), var(--blue)); border: 0; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--bg); font-weight: 700; padding: 10px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--teal); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Surface-deep ghost button with a 1px Border Steel stroke; used for secondary toolbar actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: var(--panel2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--text); padding: 3px 10px; font-size: 0.7rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--teal); color: var(--teal); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--teal); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Surface-deep text input/select with a 1px Border Steel stroke and 4–8px radius.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--panel2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--text); padding: 7px 10px; font-size: 0.78rem; width: 100%; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--teal); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Surface Slate container card with a 1px Border Steel border and 16px radius; flat depth, no shadow.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; padding: 22px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--text); } .ds-card-sub { margin: 0 0 18px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.78rem; } .ds-card-body { color: var(--text); font-size: 0.78rem; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Topbar Navigation
components.description: Surface Deep topbar with 1px Border Steel, 14px radius, flex row with space-between; houses brand, KPIs, city select, and actions.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; background: var(--panel2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px 22px; margin-bottom: 18px; } .ds-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-brand-icon { width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 10px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal), var(--blue)); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-brand-name { font-size: 1.05rem; margin: 0; letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: var(--text); } .ds-brand-sub { display: block; font-size: 0.68rem; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-live { background: rgba(45,212,191,0.12); color: var(--teal); border: 1px solid rgba(45,212,191,0.4); padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

components.name: Badge / Pill
components.description: Inline-flex badge with 20px radius; live (aqua-mint) and status variants.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 20px; padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-pill.live { background: rgba(45,212,191,0.12); color: var(--teal); border: 1px solid rgba(45,212,191,0.4); } .ds-pill.warn { background: rgba(245,148,58,0.12); color: var(--orange); border: 1px solid rgba(245,148,58,0.4); }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Fixed top-center structural overlay toast; Surface Deep with amber left accent, coral-red for error; shadow overlay.
components.css: .ds-toast { position: fixed; top: 16px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-left: 4px solid var(--orange); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 0.76rem; color: var(--text); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); z-index: 10; max-width: calc(100vw - 32px); } .ds-toast.red { border-left-color: var(--red); } .ds-toast b { display: block; margin-bottom: 2px; }

components.name: Status Segment
components.description: LED gantt track segment chips: veic (aqua-mint), res (lavender), venc (surface), livre (dashed border).
components.css: .ds-seg { height: 100%; border-radius: 6px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 0.62rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0b1224; margin-right: 3px; padding: 0 6px; flex-shrink: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-seg.veic { background: var(--teal); } .ds-seg.res { background: var(--purple); color: #fff; } .ds-seg.venc { background: #232c4e; border: 1px solid #3a4468; color: var(--muted); } .ds-seg.livre { background: transparent; border: 1px dashed #3a4468; color: var(--muted); }

narrative.overview: A clean, modern dispatch surface for scheduling LED campaigns across cities. The system reads like a signal board: dark, receding surfaces that let information — not chrome — carry the weight. Density is high but controlled: KPI strips, compact tables, and small badges sit close together within cards, while generous separation sits between major blocks so the screen never feels cramped. The philosophy is utilitarian precision dressed in a restrained dark aesthetic; color is reserved for signal (live, warn, error, status) and never used as decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Dark receding surfaces (deep-ink / surface-slate) with near-white text
Color used only as signal: aqua-mint for live/active, amber for warn, coral-red for error
Flat depth: panels separated by border-steel and tonal steps, no offset shadows
Refined and restrained components: subtle borders, muted small labels, small caps
Compact data density inside cards, generous space between sections

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The primary accent (aqua-mint) covers ≤10% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point; never use it for decoration or background fields.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover) or as structural overlays (toasts, notification panel); never as card depth.

dos: Do use aqua-mint (≤10% of screen) only for live/active signal.
Do separate panels with 1px Border Steel and tonal steps rather than shadows.
Do set labels in uppercase at 0.66rem, weight 700, tracking 0.05em.
donts: Don't add kicker/eyebrow labels above headings; the heading carries its own weight.
Don't use gradient text or glass/blur decoration.
Don't add offset (zero-blur) block shadows outside a neobrutalist world.
Don't reassert token hex values in prose; the frontmatter is normative.
